=== HINT 2: The Two Methods ===

TO_SAVE_DATA()
---------------------------------------------
Return a dictionary with everything that needs saving:
- name
- health
- max_health
- armour
- accuracy
- inventory items
- player_type (so subclasses can reload correctly)

FROM_SAVE_DATA(data) - CLASS METHOD
---------------------------------------------
This is a CLASS METHOD (called on the class, not an instance).
It creates a NEW Player from the saved data.

WHAT IS @classmethod?
- Called on the class itself
- First argument is `cls`
- Lets subclasses reuse the same pattern

Still stuck? Read hint_3.txt
